checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are largely accurate. It correctly identified that the full body, legs, and tail are untestable due to cropping. The 'is_present: false' for the ermine morph is technically correct (the feature is absent) but should not penalize alignment as the brown morph is valid. The Router was slightly lenient in not flagging the 'text_gibberish' as a failure of the 'fur texture' checkpoint, but since it created a separate artifact observation, this is acceptable. I agree with all testability judgments.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified the 'text_gibberish' as a severe artifact (Severity 4.0). The Image Text Auditor confirmed this with low confidence scores (0.52) and nonsensical output ('OOSS'), indicating hallucinated text rather than a clean watermark. The Router's severity rating is appropriate; this is a catastrophic break in photorealism. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed this because it focuses on global distortions like noise/blur, not semantic artifacts like text. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.95) only confirms the head shape is coherent, not that the surface texture is clean. I agree with the Router's assessment that this is a major defect.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class label 'weasel' (Logit 8.02) with high certainty, distinguishing it from polecats/minks. All visible anatomical checkpoints (head shape, eyes, ears, fur coloration) are present and correct. The image aligns perfectly with the taxonomy for the visible portions. The score is near-perfect because the underlying generation of the animal itself is high-quality, despite the overlay artifact.
artifact_reasoning: The primary defect is the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the neck/shoulder. The Image Text Auditor confirms these are nonsensical characters ('OOSS') with low recognition confidence, typical of AI hallucination. This breaks the realism of the image significantly. While the rest of the fur texture is high quality (Perceptual Auditor found no noise/blur), the presence of floating, unintelligible text is a severe structural/semantic error. The score is low (1.20) because such artifacts are unacceptable in high-fidelity generation, even if localized.
key_defects: Nonsensical text/gibberish overlay on the animal's neck/shoulder region.
Hallucinated characters ('OOSS') with poor integration into the fur texture.
